ui.onboarding.headline: Be ready together before an emergency.
ui.onboarding.body: Know what to prepare next, practice what your family would do in your own home, and keep a plan you can open, share or print without the internet.
ui.onboarding.point1: Practice a fire, flood, freeze or other emergency in your own home, one decision at a time.
ui.onboarding.point2: Get the few preparations that matter most, plus an emergency card with contacts, meeting places and critical needs.
ui.onboarding.demoNote: Uses a made-up family. Nothing is saved about you.
ui.onboarding.sampleHint: Loads a made-up household and sample home
ui.setup.area.question: Which language and county?
ui.setup.area.why: Your county picks the local help numbers. Your address is not needed.
ui.setup.people.question: Who lives here?
ui.setup.people.why: Nicknames are fine. Recording needs lets the rehearsal plan who helps whom; no diagnosis is needed.
ui.setup.medical.question: Does anyone rely on powered medical equipment or medication that must stay cold?
ui.setup.medical.why: For example oxygen, CPAP, a power wheelchair, or insulin. This matters most in a power outage.
ui.setup.medical.none: If no one does, tap Next.
ui.setup.backup.question: Do you have any backup power?
ui.setup.backup.why: A battery station, generator, or solar with battery. Say whether it works with each device, but only if the supplier confirmed it.
ui.setup.home.question: How is your home heated and where does your water come from?
ui.setup.home.why: These decide what stops working when the power goes out.
ui.setup.contacts.question: Who should people call?
ui.setup.contacts.why: An out-of-area contact everyone can reach, and the equipment supplier or care team.
ui.setup.travel.question: Getting around, pets, and supplies
ui.setup.travel.why: Leave anything you're not sure about. You can change it later.
ui.setup.countyFooter: Only your county is used to choose public resources. It stays on this phone.
ui.setup.heatNeedsPower: Heat needs electricity (controls, blower, or electric heat)
ui.setup.heatFooter: Many gas furnaces still need electricity for the blower or controls. If you're not sure, choose Not sure.
ui.setup.noCarFooter: No car is a fully supported plan. Arranging a ride ahead of time matters more than owning one.

family.reviewNow: We reviewed this card and its contacts today
reminder.title: Optional review reminder
reminder.optional: Choose a one-time local reminder if it helps. Nothing is scheduled until you tap Schedule. Notifications contain only a general review prompt.
reminder.notificationBody: Check that your contacts, meeting places and preparation records are current.
reminder.saved: Review reminder scheduled on this device.

reminder.invalidDate: Choose a future date and time.

prep.alerts.why: For supported local coverage, record your actual alert enrollment and how to receive it.
prep.medication.title: Check essential medication availability

prep.equipmentSupplies.why: Record the availability and location of required supplies for {device}; use manufacturer or provider instructions.
prep.location.why: You have recorded having this preparation: {item}. Add where to find it or the agreed instructions.
family.radioAlternative: Record radio ownership above. Below, you can instead confirm an agreed way to receive alerts, with finding or access instructions.
family.medicationAvailability: Record only availability and where to find the medicine. Follow its labeling and check missing instructions with a pharmacist or clinician.
family.equipmentSupplies: Use the manufacturer or provider’s list of required supplies. Ownership of supplies does not confirm equipment backup compatibility.

prep.fireDrill.why: Record a real family fire-escape drill and the plan you practiced. A digital exercise or an exit check alone is not a household drill.
prep.wellFloodPlan.title: Plan well testing after a flood

prep.coAlarms.acquire.title: Install CO alarms

prep.flashlight.acquire.title: Get flashlights
prep.batteries.acquire.title: Get batteries or a power bank
prep.acquire.why: You recorded not having this yet. What to buy lists a household-sized amount with a planning price range.
prep.alarm.acquire.why: No working alarm is recorded. Install alarms following the maker's instructions. Renters can ask the landlord, and some local fire departments offer free or low-cost alarms.
prep.extinguisher.check.title: Check the fire extinguisher
prep.extinguisher.check.why: You recorded where it is. Check the gauge and label using the maker's instructions, record the date, and make sure the adults at home know where it is. Getting everyone out comes first.
prep.coldStorage.continuity.title: Plan outage storage for {device}
prep.coldStorage.continuity.why: You recorded how {device} must be stored. Plan how to keep it that way if the power fails, such as a cooler with ice packs or a place with power, and confirm the plan with a pharmacist. Do not assume a safe time out of storage.
prep.stairPlan.title: Plan a way out from upstairs
prep.stairPlan.why: {person} sleeps above the lowest floor and has a recorded stair or mobility need, with no helper assigned. Agree who helps, consider a lower-floor sleeping room, and record the plan. Nobody re-enters danger.
prep.stairPlan.helper.why: {person} sleeps above the lowest floor and has a recorded stair or mobility need. A helper is assigned; agree how they get down or out together, and record the plan.
prep.stairPlan.unknown.why: {person} has a recorded stair or mobility need in a home with more than one floor. Record where {person} sleeps, or record the agreed plan for stairs.
family.stairInstructions: Agreed plan: who helps and how
family.stairPlanNote: Follow care-team or fire-department advice for moving someone on stairs. Nobody is assigned to re-enter danger.

score.title: Preparedness score
score.sharedEscape: In a practice fire, both escape paths pass through: {places}. If that point is blocked, neither path works.
score.howBody: 90% comes from the preparations you have recorded and 10% from a short practice check. Unknown items earn nothing but are not counted as failures. A missing critical item caps the total until it is resolved.
score.notSafety: This summarizes documented preparation under a draft rubric. It is not a safety rating, a prediction, or a comparison with other families.
score.criterion.assistance: Help for people who need it

inventory.title: What you already have
inventory.openDetail: List supplies item by item, review them once, and see what is still short. Items you list here become the recorded amounts.

inventory.quantityHint: Leave empty if you are not sure.
inventory.invalidQuantity: Enter a whole number for counted items, or a positive amount.
inventory.saveFailed: Not saved. Your list was kept; try again.
inventory.useRecordedWater: Add your recorded {amount} of water to this list
inventory.gapsFooter: Water uses at least 1 gallon per person per day for 3 days (CDC); food uses 3 days for the whole household. These are planning minimums, not a full recommendation.
inventory.gapUnknown: Not enough recorded to tell. Add the amount, and mark whether it is ready to use and easy to reach.
inventory.managedThere: Water is recorded item by item in “What you already have”
practice.title: Practice check
practice.cardDetail: Four short questions in your own home. Your first answers count toward the practice part of the score.
practice.intro: Four short, separate practice situations: a fire starting, a blocked way out, reaching your contact during a water outage, and using stored water. Answer as you would really act.
practice.rules: Your first answer to each is saved before you see any feedback, and feedback never changes it. Take as long as you need; time is not measured. It adds at most 10 points and is not a safety rating.
practice.needsHome: Add your home layout first. The fire situations use your own rooms.
practice.separate: Each situation is separate and practice only.
practice.chooseOne: Choose what you would do. Only actions this practice can model are listed.
practice.recorded: Your answer was saved before this feedback.
practice.doneBody: Situations this app cannot judge for your household stay unassessed; they are not counted as wrong. You can practice freely in any exercise; a new check starts fresh.
practice.unavailable: The practice check needs your home layout and a supported water situation.

places.stated.wheelchairAccessible.false: Not wheelchair accessible (as stated by FEMA)
places.stated.adaCompliant.false: Not ADA compliant (as stated by FEMA)
places.noAccessInfo: The source does not say whether it is step-free. Ask when you call.
places.routeNote: Route by Apple Maps. It is not checked for step-free access, flooding or closures.
places.routeFailed: No route found. Check the address in Maps.
places.note.power-person: {person} needs an outlet for the {equipment}. Ask before you go.
places.note.power: The {equipment} needs an outlet. Ask before you go.
places.note.cold: Bring a cooler for the {equipment}; ask if a fridge is available.
places.note.step-free: Ask for a step-free entrance for {person}.
places.open: Where to go: shelters and cooling centers
rings.done: You've done {count} things so far. Nice work — keep going.
rings.start: Start with the first item below. Every step counts.
rings.provisional: Provisional score out of 100 — a summary of what you've recorded, not a safety rating.
debrief.ai.title: Beacon's debrief
debrief.ai.note: Beacon only points at what this rehearsal already recommended. A rehearsal is practice, not a promise.
debrief.ai.unavailable: Beacon was unavailable. The app's own debrief is below.
drill.ai.title: Beacon's drill setup
drill.ai.run: Let Beacon set up this drill
drill.ai.note: Beacon filled in the choices below. Change any of them before you start.
drill.ai.unavailable: Beacon was unavailable. Choose the setup yourself.
adaptive.cloud.detail: Example household only. Sends anonymized needs, home layout IDs and this exercise's state (no names, phone numbers or address) to Google Gemini through the Dry Run test server. The app checks every suggestion before it happens.
map.forTasksFooter: Picked from your open preparations. Stock, hours and services are not checked; call before you go. Listings stay on this phone.
map.forTasksEmpty: No matching places nearby. Try the map search or a wider area.
map.forTasksNone: None of your open tasks needs a nearby place right now.
resource.purpose.water: A store where you could buy drinking water before an outage, for your water task.
resource.purpose.food: A place to get shelf-stable food before an emergency, for your food task.
resource.purpose.light: A store that may sell flashlights and batteries, for your light task.
resource.purpose.alarms: A store that may sell smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, for your alarm task.
resource.purpose.firstAid: A pharmacy that may sell first aid supplies, for your first aid task.
resource.purpose.medication: A pharmacy to ask about keeping enough medication on hand.
resource.purpose.equipment: A nearby place that may carry medical supplies, to ask about backup options for essential equipment.
resource.purpose.heatCold: An official warming or cooling location listed for your county.
resource.purpose.officialPlanning: Your county's official emergency planning office.
resource.unknown.outageOperation: whether it will be open during an outage
resource.unknown.eligibility: who it serves and what is needed
resource.unknown.compatibility: whether anything fits your equipment (ask the manufacturer or supplier)
resource.unknown.activation: whether it is open or activated now
resource.unknown.access: how to get there and accessibility
resource.evidence.manufacturer: Check backup compatibility with the manufacturer or supplier
resource.evidence.official: Confirm with the official source before relying on it
resource.boundary.policeStation: A public-service location only; not evidence that it accepts evacuees or serves as a shelter.
resource.boundary.fireStation: A public-service location only; not evidence that it accepts evacuees or serves as a shelter.
resource.boundary.trustedMeetup: A candidate for your household to review; a listing is not agreement or availability.
resource.boundary.hospital: Facility type and capabilities need confirming; being nearby does not make it the right place for a medical emergency.
resource.boundary.warmingCooling: Service and activation must be confirmed with the official source.
resource.boundary.shelter: Service, activation and accessibility must be confirmed with the official source.
resource.boundary.equipmentSupplier: A store listing; it does not show the store has, or can set up, a backup for your equipment.
site.title: Location records
site.homeFooter: Official flood, elevation, wildfire and hurricane planning records for this address, with their sources.
site.intro: Copy a record from an official source (for example your county, FEMA or the state) with where it came from. You review it before it is saved. These are planning records, not a current warning or evacuation order.
site.needsCounty: Choose your county in the household details first. Records only count for the county they come from.
site.otherAddress: These records were saved for a different address or home. They no longer count; review them or remove them.
site.flood.unknown: Not compared (needs a finished-floor elevation and a flood level in the same datum)
site.flood.aboveDesignLevel: Recorded floor is above the recorded design level, beyond the stated uncertainty. This is not a guarantee of staying dry.
site.flood.belowDesignLevel: Recorded floor is below the recorded design level, beyond the stated uncertainty.
site.flood.overlappingUncertainty: Too close to tell within the stated uncertainty.
site.hurricane.recorded: Zone and planning route recorded (follow official orders when they are issued)
site.sourceDoesNotCount: Does not count (expired, another county, or not secure)
site.limits: What these records cannot tell you
site.limit.terrain: Ground elevation is not your floor height, and room heights in the app are not elevations above sea level.
site.limit.wildfire: A community wildfire rating describes the area, not this home or a current fire.
site.limit.hurricane: A planning zone and route are not an evacuation order or a route that is safe right now.
site.limit.scope: Wildfire and hurricane exercises and scoring are outside what this app currently reviews.
site.removeConfirm: Remove all location records for this address?
site.datumHint: Use the datum printed on the source. If it is not stated, leave this record out; unknown datums are never compared.
site.copied: I copied this from the official source
site.reviewBody: {record}: {detail}. Source: {publisher}. It is stored encrypted on this phone.
site.saveFailed: Not saved. Nothing was changed; try again.
site.problem.source: Add the publisher and an https link to the official source.
site.problem.copied: Confirm that you copied this from the official source.
site.problem.number: Enter the value and its uncertainty as numbers.
site.problem.datum: Enter the vertical datum printed on the source.
site.problem.zone: Enter the zone and the planning route as printed.
photo.title: Check a room photo (optional)
photo.intro: Pick one photo of a room. It is redrawn, scaled down and saved as a new image without location or camera details. Only that image and your home layout IDs are sent, after you agree. You decide what each finding means.
photo.preview: The photo that would be sent
photo.synthetic: Synthetic test image (not a real room)
photo.minimized: Will send {width} × {height} pixels, location and camera details removed
photo.consent: Send this photo to Google Gemini for review
photo.consentDetail: Sent through the Dry Run test server with your home layout IDs (no names, phone numbers or address). The photo is not saved on this phone or by Dry Run; Google's own retention rules apply.
photo.noService: Photo review needs the Dry Run test server in this build. You can still record exits, markers and notes in the home editor.
photo.failed: The review did not finish. Nothing was saved; you can try again or edit the home yourself.
photo.none: Nothing was pointed out. That does not mean the room is safe; parts of a room can be hidden or unclear in a photo.
photo.category.supplyAccess: Supplies may be hard to reach
photo.decided.confirmed: Confirmed and linked to your preparation
photo.decided.dismissed: Marked not an issue; it will not be raised again for this photo
photo.decided.uncertain: Left as not sure; nothing changed
photo.notSafe: Findings are suggestions from a photo. They do not certify a room, an exit or equipment.
photo.linkedExits: Keep exits and the way out clear
photo.linkedSupplies: Keep emergency supplies easy to reach
photo.noPoints: A confirmed photo finding points you to a preparation; it does not complete it or add points.
photo.needsHome: Add your home layout first so findings can be tied to a room.
map.geminiPlansDetail: Example household only. Sends anonymized needs and open tasks (no address, location or map results) to Google Gemini through the Dry Run test server. The app checks every plan.
map.plannedByGemini: Searches planned by Gemini, checked by the app
map.geminiRejected: Gemini's plans did not pass the app's checks, so this phone's plans are shown.
map.geminiUnavailable: Gemini was unavailable, so this phone's plans are shown.
site.lookup.flood: Look up FEMA's flood map for this address
site.lookup.elevation: Look up USGS ground elevation for this address
site.lookup.needsAddress: Save your home's address with a map location first to use a lookup.
site.lookup.consentFlood: Only the latitude and longitude of your saved address go to FEMA's public flood map service. No names or other details are sent. You review the result before anything is saved.
site.lookup.consentElevation: Only the latitude and longitude of your saved address go to the USGS public elevation service. No names or other details are sent. You review the result before anything is saved.
site.lookup.zone: FEMA flood zone: {zone}. This is planning information, not a forecast.
site.lookup.sfha: FEMA marks this point as a special flood hazard area.
site.lookup.bfeFilled: The base flood elevation and its datum were filled in from FEMA. FEMA does not state an uncertainty, so enter one from your source, then check every field.
site.lookup.noBFE: FEMA lists no base flood elevation at this point, so nothing was filled in.
site.lookup.notMapped: FEMA's digital flood map shows no flood zone at this point. That does not mean there is no flood risk.
site.lookup.ambiguous: This point touches more than one FEMA flood zone. Check the map yourself at msc.fema.gov.
site.lookup.elevationFilled: Ground elevation was filled in from USGS. This result does not state a datum or an uncertainty, so enter both from the USGS source before saving.
site.lookup.noElevation: USGS has no elevation for this point.
site.lookup.failed: The lookup did not work. Check your connection, or enter the record by hand.
prep.ai.detail: Example household only. Sends anonymized needs, equipment, recorded supplies and home layout IDs (no names, phone numbers or address) to Google Gemini through the Dry Run test server. Gemini can reorder items within the same priority and explain them for this household. The app checks each one against your list; priority, the score and what is done never change.
